title: Investment Banking Analyst – Real Estate, L&L

titleByLocale.it: Investment Banking Analista – Real Estate, L&L
titleByLocale.de: Investment Banking Analyst – Real Estate, L&L
titleByLocale.fr: Investment Banking Analyste – Real Estate, L&L

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you an analytical thinker with outstanding attention to detail, sound judgement and a relentless work ethic? Do you excel in demanding environments and enjoy translating complex financial and strategic questions into clear, persuasive materials for clients, investors and senior stakeholders?

We’re looking for outstanding junior talent with the potential to develop quickly. As high-performing investment banking analyst you will:

• •prepare high-quality marketing and transaction materials that distil industry dynamics, valuation considerations and strategic alternatives into clear, compelling recommendations for clients
• •contribute to differentiated ideas and thoughtful strategic perspectives that strengthen client dialogue and support origination efforts
• •support senior bankers in anticipating client priorities, executing against live opportunities and working seamlessly with internal and external stakeholders
•build and maintain rigorous financial and valuation models across live transactions and strategic assignments, including M&A, IPOs, follow-ons, private capital raising and other real estate, lodging and leisure corporate finance situations
•identify key issues early, assess alternatives with sound judgement and help drive practical, well-reasoned solutions under tight timelines
